segments.text:
V. 18.
He that believeth on him is not condemned—Is acquitted, is juſtified before GOD. The name of the only begotten Son of God—The Name of a Perſon is often put for the Perſon himſelf. But perhaps it is farther intimated in that Expreſſion, That the Perſon ſpoken of is great and magnificent. And therefore it is generally uſed to expreſs either GOD the Father, or the Son.
